start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-each-task-input-and-list-on-the-one-record-book with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"} and bindings [{\"identities\": [{\"kind\": \"list\", \"id\": \"l1\"}], \"group\": null, \"book\": null}] and candidates [{\"owner\": \"account-a\", \"resource\": \"book-1\"}]."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the bindings are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-each-task-input-and-list-on-the-one-record-book" with store, the bindings to keep, the lookups and the candidate books. Ask the person before choosing a book for them.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example attempts; every attempt must come out as the prove step says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run keeps the new bindings through those objects and reads each one back.

worked_examples.title: A list bound once, then looked up
worked_examples.ask: Bind list l1 to the first candidate book, then tell me which book holds l1.

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The look step found the bindings kept by an earlier run.

worked_examples.title: A binding to a second book is refused
worked_examples.ask: Bind task t1 to book-2 although it is on book-1.

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

worked_examples.given: task t1 is bound to book-1 by an earlier run.
worked_examples.hands_back: refused [{"identity": "task t1", "why": "already bound to another book"}] and nothing kept for it.

worked_examples.title: A relationship group goes to one book
worked_examples.ask: Bind list l2 and task t2 together to book-2.

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The group g1 is not yet bound.
worked_examples.hands_back: kept ["list l2", "task t2"] both on book-2, read back the same.
